_comment: MCP servers for Claude Code sessions on this repo.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Connecting Supabase at claude.ai does NOT give it to a
Claude Code session. Those are two different surfaces: the claude.ai
connector list feeds claude.ai chats, and Claude Code reads its servers from
its own config — this file, plus user/project settings. Every connector on
the account reported connected:true and enabledInChat:false at once, which is
the tell: nothing was toggled off, the session simply never consumes that
list. Only the GitHub server, provisioned by the environment, was ever here.
That cost most of a day: Tara Lodge agreed a partnership on 12 August and
could not be written to the database, and Jack Daniels' gym had its map off
for a day, both waiting on a tool rather than a decision.
SETUP — one thing, once. This file carries NO secret and must not. The server
reads SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN from the environment, so add it as an environment
variable on the Claude Code environment (not here, not in git):
Supabase dashboard -> Account -> Access Tokens -> Generate new token
Claude Code -> environment settings -> add SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN
There is deliberately no `env` block below: the server process inherits the
environment, so inheritance does the job without depending on how this file
expands variables.
Scoped to the ParkEasy project with --project-ref, so a session here cannot
reach another project by accident. NOT --read-only: writing partner rows is
the entire reason for it.
Takes effect in a NEW session — a running one keeps the servers it started
with, which is why none of today's reconnecting changed anything.
